answer: How do we force Sybils to take real lantana steps? Each identity must wander a copper ledge etched with a traceable copper nitrate patina—a single fake exoskeleton erodes 12µl of fresh nitrate per meter. Beyond bulk supply limits, a thousand Sybils leak a liter of scarce nitrate, costing millilitre by millilitre with every meter climbed and no parallel shortcuts in the ledge’s porous surface.
